description: Upload an existing MP4, WebM or MOV clip to your own Picorn account. No video generation, editing or rendering. Pass raw mediaBase64 and contentType; maximum 15 MB decoded. Download a licensed source clip in your client first; a webpage URL is not video bytes. Returns fileId, mediaUrl and published:false. Inspect the clip, then publish with picorn_posts_schedule using that fileId, exact accountIds and publishNow:true or scheduledAt. Upload alone does not publish or incur a social posting charge. Requires account access.
name: picorn_posts_upload_video
title: Picorn Posts: upload an existing video
